This is a sources sought notice only. No synopsis or solicitation are being issued at this time. The amount of information available for publication at this time is limited. This notice is also for the purpose of market research in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10.

Please provide any sources that may be able to manufacture the NSN listed below. All of the items’ technical data can be accessed in the cFolders (https://pcf1x.bsm.dla.mil/cfolders/) using project number “CL25342003”. All information may be submitted to Michael Proskurenko by email at Michael.Proskurenko@dla.mil. All deliveries will be made to DLA Depots. Any information must be provided by the response date of this notification.
